sdc.daemon.AnswererLabel.title: AnswererLabel
sdc.daemon.AnswererLabel.description: The name a client gives when it answers a decision (the answered_by of AnswerDecision): free text, at most 200 characters, like ClientLabel. The daemon refuses a longer one (400). It is stored and shown as given and is never the principal: the principal of an answer is the daemon's own (runbook serve --principal), fixed when the daemon starts, and a label a client types grants nothing.
